capabilities.name: Versioned graph document validation
capabilities.description: Validates graph documents against the strict versioned graph schema and enforces source, evidence, entity and relationship integrity rules.

capabilities.name: Evidence-backed provenance model
capabilities.description: Models source, evidence and entity nodes with evidence-referenced relationships and explicit uncertainty; referential integrity is checked before graph use.

capabilities.name: Deterministic graph serialization
capabilities.description: Serializes graph documents in deterministic identifier order and loads dependent evidence records after their source records.

capabilities.name: Bounded graph path queries
capabilities.description: Provides adjacency and bounded path queries with explicit maximum depth, result-count, expansion, queue and edge-scan work budgets.
limitations: Path queries raise a ValueError when any configured work budget is exhausted; they do not silently truncate results.

explicit_non_capabilities: network ingestion or external API access
